chain.title: Something To Smash With
chain.desc: Livingwood twig and manasteel. Hammers are Extrabotany's second crafting surface: you throw an item onto a pedestal and hit it, and nothing further in this mod works without one.

chain.title: The Anvil Underneath
chain.desc: A livingrock pedestal holds the item a hammer smashes. Calcite is the alternate material if you prefer the paler block.

chain.title: Fuel For The Grinder
chain.desc: Spirit fuel is what a hammer strikes on a pedestal to make spirit fragments. It is the throttle on this mod's entire mid game.

chain.title: Shards Of Something Willing
chain.desc: Smash spirit fuel on a pedestal. Fragments buy the three special metals and half the exotic flowers.

chain.title: The Absurd Reagent
chain.desc: A gilded potato mashed under a hammer becomes the catalyst in every runic-altar metal recipe here. Extrabotany is entirely serious about this.

chain.title: Metal Made Of Light
chain.desc: Runic Altar: elementium, mashed gilded potato and a spirit fragment. Photonium is the light-aligned half of Extrabotany's metal pair.

chain.title: Coal That Dreams Badly
chain.desc: Mana infusion on ordinary coal. It is the dark reagent photonium's opposite number needs.

chain.title: Metal Made Of Absence
chain.desc: Runic Altar: elementium, mashed gilded potato and nightmare fuel. Shadowium and photonium are always made as a pair.

chain.title: A Plate Of Living Earth
chain.desc: Terrasteel around a vanilla shield. Botania never made a shield; this is the first rung of a ladder ending in the Achilles Shield.

chain.title: Proof You Beat The Guardian
chain.desc: The Hero Medal has no crafting recipe - it comes off the Guardian of Gaia. Excalibur, the Gaia Hammer, orichalcos and the Achilles Shield all consume one.

chain.title: The Metal Of The Ancients
chain.desc: Runic Altar: a Gaia ingot, life essence, mashed gilded potato and a hero medal. The top metal, and the only one costing a Gaia kill twice over.

chain.title: Ingot Of Thin Air
chain.desc: Terra Plate: dragonstone, an ender air bottle and phantom membrane. The lightest metal here and the base of the flight items.

chain.title: Where It Began
chain.desc: Terrasteel, aerialite and a spirit fragment. First of three cosmic stones; a mana infusion on it also yields an Elytra.

chain.title: Light Against Shadow
chain.desc: Photonium, shadowium and a spirit fragment pressed together. The second stone, and the one that opens the Dimension Catalyst.

chain.title: Where It Stops
chain.desc: Gaia ingot, orichalcos and a spirit fragment. The third stone, and the most expensive single craft short of the Terra Plate recipes.

chain.title: All Three At Once
chain.desc: A Terra Plate agglomeration of Origin, Chaos and End. Extrabotany's endgame token.

chain.title: Drawn, Not Crafted
chain.desc: Smithing a hero medal and a dreamwood twig onto a Terra Blade. It hits harder the more health you are missing.

chain.title: The Bow That Never Misses
chain.desc: Gaia ingot, mana string and orichalcos. Fires arrows that ignore the arc entirely.

chain.title: The Guardian's Own Weight
chain.desc: Smithing a Gaia ingot and a hero medal onto the Terra Smasher. Both a weapon and the pedestal hammer that unlocks the last recipes.

chain.title: Every Hammer, Melted Together
chain.desc: A Terra Plate recipe consuming all eight lesser hammers plus Das Rheingold. Extrabotany's completion trophy.

chain.title: Invulnerable, Mostly
chain.desc: Smithing orichalcos and a hero medal onto the Terrasteel Shield. It blocks from every angle except the one that matters.

chain.title: Overlord Of The Great Tomb
chain.desc: Gaia ingot and Das Rheingold worked onto a terrasteel helmet. The set is a straight upgrade over terrasteel armour.

chain.title: Calling The Third Guardian
chain.desc: Gaia ingot, life essence, photonium and shadowium. It summons Guardian of Gaia III, a tier above anything Botania spawns.

chain.title: The Guardian, Third Time
chain.desc: Guardian of Gaia III has its own loot table and is the hardest fight in the Botania ecosystem.

notes: 155 ids resolve as assets/extrabotany/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. Progression read from data/extrabotany/recipes/*.json: the mod's private recipe types are pedestal_smash (throw an item on a pedestal, hit it with a hammer), runic_altar, terra_plate, mana_infusion and mana_upgrade. spirit_fuel -> spirit_fragment and gilded_potato -> gilded_potato_mashed are both pedestal_smash, which is why a hammer is step one. hero_medal has no crafting recipe in the jar - it is a Guardian of Gaia drop - and it gates orichalcos_ingot, excalibur, gaia_hammer, achilles_shield, magic_finger and feather_of_jingwei. gaia_3rd and gaia_legacy are the only two entities with loot tables (data/extrabotany/loot_tables/entities/); the other seven entity lang keys (aura_fire, magic_landmine, skull_missile, the three skull_landmine colours, holy_water_grenade) are projectiles and traps and are NOT questable kills. The quartz slab/stair/pillar/smooth variants and the twenty potted_* blocks are deliberately excluded. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: botania:terrasteel_ingot, botania:elementium_ingot, botania:gaia_ingot, botania:life_essence, botania:runic_altar, botania:terra_plate, botania:alchemy_catalyst, botania:terra_sword, botania:manaweave_cloth, botania:livingwood_twig, botania:dreamwood_twig, botania:lens_normal, a completed Guardian of Gaia ritual.
